title: Scaling the cost bound
statement: Let $P$ be a program, let $p,d,c,c',S$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{vals}$ be a finite list of integers, let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ be an initial memory, and let $R$ be a predicate on an integer and a memory function. If the call to procedure $p$ on $\mathrm{vals}$ from memory $\mu$ at depth $d$ meets cost bound $cS$ and postcondition $R$, and $c\le c'$, then it meets cost bound $c'S$ with the same postcondition.
